name: Zhejiang Fenglong Electric Co., Ltd.
summary: Zhejiang Fenglong Electric Co., Ltd. engages in the research and development, production, and sale of garden machinery parts, automobile parts, and hydraulic parts in China. The company offers garden machinery, including electric machinery and internal combustion machinery, as well as hydraulic components, such as hydraulic valves and hydraulic valve block; and auto parts comprising aluminum die cast and system components. Its products are used in lawn mowers, chain saws, hedge trimmers, automotive transmission, braking, temperature control systems, new energy vehicles, and precision control units for engineering machinery, industrial machinery, and semiconductor equipment.
